structured_requirements.name: AI Job Portal Platform Vision
structured_requirements.description: Create a user-friendly job portal specialising in AI and machine learning positions, enabling candidates to easily apply for positions and recruiters to efficiently manage applications via a centralised hub with role-based access.

structured_requirements.name: Efficiency — Reduce Manual Effort
structured_requirements.description: Reduce manual effort in application and review processes by 60% through automation and streamlined workflows.

structured_requirements.name: User Adoption — Candidate Registrations
structured_requirements.description: Achieve 500+ registered candidates in Q1 to validate platform adoption.

structured_requirements.name: Recruiter Satisfaction
structured_requirements.description: Achieve an 85%+ recruiter satisfaction rating with the platform's application management features.

structured_requirements.name: Application Completion Rate
structured_requirements.description: Achieve an 80%+ application completion rate, ensuring candidates who start an application successfully submit it.

structured_requirements.name: Time-to-Review Reduction
structured_requirements.description: Reduce average recruiter review time by 40% through dashboard tooling and resume management features.

structured_requirements.name: User Registration
structured_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to register as either a Candidate or Recruiter. Users can select their role during registration. Password must meet security requirements: minimum 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character. Email verification is not required.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select role (Candidate or Recruiter) during registration
Password min 8 chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, number, special character

structured_requirements.name: User Login
structured_requirements.description: The system shall provide secure login functionality for both Candidates and Recruiters using email and password credentials with session management.
acceptance_criteria: Users can log in with email and password

structured_requirements.name: Resume Upload
structured_requirements.description: Candidates shall be able to upload their resume. Supported formats are PDF, DOC, and DOCX with a maximum file size of 5 MB. The system must display an upload progress indicator, success/error messages, and allow preview of the uploaded resume.

structured_requirements.name: Job Position Selection
structured_requirements.description: Candidates shall select a job position from a dropdown menu listing all active hardcoded AI skill roles. Single selection is allowed per application. Job descriptions must be visible on hover or expand. Field is mandatory.
acceptance_criteria: Dropdown lists all active hardcoded AI roles
Job description visible on hover or expand

structured_requirements.name: Application Submission
structured_requirements.description: Candidates shall submit their application consisting of their uploaded resume and selected job position. All mandatory fields must be completed. A confirmation message and unique application reference number must be generated upon successful submission.
acceptance_criteria: All mandatory fields must be filled before submission
Confirmation message displayed on successful submission

structured_requirements.name: Recruiter Resume Dashboard
structured_requirements.description: Recruiters shall view all submitted resumes and application details in a dashboard. The dashboard must display candidate name, applied position, submission date, and status. Pagination at 20 records per page and sort by date, position, and candidate name are required. A download resume button must be present per record.
acceptance_criteria: List view of all submitted applications
Display: candidate name, applied position, submission date, status
Sort by date, position, and candidate name

structured_requirements.name: AI Job Positions — Dropdown Options
structured_requirements.description: The job position dropdown must include the following 15 hardcoded AI roles: Machine Learning Engineer, AI Research Scientist, Data Scientist, Deep Learning Engineer, NLP Engineer, Computer Vision Engineer, AI/ML Solutions Architect, MLOps Engineer, Prompt Engineer, AI Product Manager, Robotics Engineer, AI Ethics Specialist, Conversational AI Developer, AI Data Engineer, Generative AI Specialist.

structured_requirements.name: User Data Model
structured_requirements.description: User entity must store: User ID (PK), Email (Unique), Password (Encrypted), Role, First Name, Last Name, Phone Number, Created Date, Last Login, Account Status.

structured_requirements.name: Candidate Profile Data Model
structured_requirements.description: Candidate profile entity must store: Profile ID (PK), User ID (FK), Skills (Array), Experience Level, Preferred Location, LinkedIn URL, Resume File Path, Updated Date.

structured_requirements.name: Job Position Data Model
structured_requirements.description: Job Position entity must store: Job ID (PK), Job Title, Description, Required Skills, Experience Required, Location, Employment Type, Status, Created By, Created Date.

structured_requirements.name: Application Data Model
structured_requirements.description: Application entity must store: Application ID (PK), Candidate ID (FK), Job ID (FK), Resume File Name, Resume File Path, Submission Date, Application Status, Status Updated Date, Updated By (FK).

structured_requirements.name: Candidate End-to-End Workflow
structured_requirements.description: Candidate workflow: (1) Register or Login, (2) Fill profile information, (3) Select AI skills from checklist, (4) Browse available job positions, (5) Select desired job from dropdown, (6) Upload resume (PDF/DOC), (7) Submit application, (8) System validates all fields, (9) System stores resume and application data.
steps: System stores resume and application data

structured_requirements.name: Recruiter End-to-End Workflow
structured_requirements.description: Recruiter workflow: (1) Login, (2) Land on dashboard showing all applications, (3) Apply filters by position, date, and skills, (4) Review candidate information, (5) Download resume for detailed review, (6) Continue reviewing next application.

structured_requirements.name: Technical Constraint — Web Only
structured_requirements.description: The system is web-based only. No mobile application in Phase 1. Must be compatible with Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+, and Edge 90+. Internet connection required. English language only in Phase 1.

structured_requirements.name: Technical Constraint — File Restrictions
structured_requirements.description: Resume file size strictly limited to 5 MB. Supported file formats are PDF, DOC, and DOCX only. No other formats accepted.

structured_requirements.name: Out of Scope — Future Phases
structured_requirements.description: The following features are explicitly out of scope for Phase 1: advanced AI-based resume screening, automated candidate-job matching algorithms, interview scheduling, candidate-recruiter messaging, payment processing for premium features, mobile application, social media integration, and background verification services.

structured_requirements.name: Assumption — User Load
structured_requirements.description: Initial user load will be moderate, under 5,000 users. Users have valid email addresses, internet access, and modern web browsers. Candidates have resumes prepared in supported formats. Job positions will be pre-populated by system administrators.

user_stories.ac: Registration form with role selection and password validation
Upload PDF/DOC/DOCX files up to 5 MB with preview
Dropdown menu with AI job positions, mandatory selection
Successful submission with confirmation and reference number
Dashboard with list of all applications, sort and pagination
Download button for each resume record
